title: http2: Improve PUSH_PROMISE handling
description:
Track the promised stream id for the current field block (HEADERS
or PUSH_PROMISE) and associate header fields with the correct
stream id. The file from #13543 provides some examples of PUSH_PROMISE,
and this fixes Export Objects for HTTP2 for that file.

There were a few cases previously where PUSH_PROMISE field blocks
that come before the HEADERS field start were being added to the
list of HEADERS for the current stream ID. In other cases (e.g.
when after the HEADERS field block) it was being discarded.

Only update the header_start_in and header_end_in information on
the first pass (that's the only time we used it.) If we do want
access on subsequent passes, then the full list of information would
have to be stored (e.g., in a wmem_list_t).

Also add the link to the response frame number for PUSH_PROMISE
requests.
